metadata.correctness: All 156 complete imports passed. All 221 fixed work/configuration fields agreed within each job. Complete importer/parser row counts, sampled public content/media readbacks and post-restart probes matched. All 130 phase metrics are retained.

notClaimed: A cheap-writeback speedup distinguishable from controls
Replicated expensive-path benefit across two independent expensive hosts
decision.reason: VNDB expensive-writeback replica improved in all eight pairs with separate near-zero controls. The cheap-writeback replica stopped after one probe and had similar candidate/control change magnitudes, with no demonstrated speedup. Small sidecars never checkpoint and show no demonstrated benefit.

metadata.hostedValidation: Ordinary CI run 45123840948 succeeded at qualification dba340e1548b0b88edfe96aa179c0e7d548e7547. Full unit log: 628 test files, 14016 passed tests, 47 skipped tests. Run and all job metadata retained.
limitations: One expensive VNDB host and one cheap VNDB host exercised distinct adaptive modes; the expensive-host speedup is conditional evidence, not two independent expensive-host replications.
The cheap-host candidate/control comparison does not establish statistical equivalence. No browser observation exercised an expensive-to-cheap transition; that transition is covered by focused tests.
Reported phases overlap and are not additive; worker timing sums are not critical-path shares.
Sampled public readbacks and complete reported counts do not prove exhaustive byte equality of all stored records.
Memory observations are retained as originally reported; this campaign does not establish production peak memory equivalence.

localPublicTreeEquivalence.snapshotPolicy: Runtime and test snapshots come from frozen Git commit blobs. Live worktree production files are not used.

metadata.localValidation: Retains all adaptive receipts, frozen source snapshots, the initial test-fixture setup timeout and passing recheck. An unmeasured size-only 32 MiB intermediate is included solely for source/validation provenance.
metadata.omissions: Only duplicate rendered HTML reports are omitted from these six original ZIPs. No adaptive diagnostic trace was collected. Every raw timed and warmup JSON, run log, source map, harness, overlay, verifier, lock, order, host snapshot and comparison is retained exactly.

priorRejectedCampaign.decision: Fixed 16 MiB screen improvement failed independent confirmation; retained separately and not pooled with this revision.

metadata.sourceSnapshotPolicy: Frozen Git blobs bind baseline, candidate product and qualification helpers; local/public tree equivalence is checked. No current mutable runtime files are used.
metadata.timingInterpretation: Every corpus, replication, adaptive mode and same-product control remains separate. No host pooling, control subtraction, tail removal, outcome-dependent retries, or additional timing observations.
metadata.title: Adaptive import-index checkpoints: complete fixed two-replica qualification
